purpose: Supporting analysis reference, not a mandatory workflow for writing fiction

coverage.note: Only complete coverage for a label family makes no positive span a zero; partial/unreviewed is unknown.

offsets: Unicode codepoints in matching *.main.analysis.txt, half-open [start,end); core clipped for rates; quote must equal text[start:end]
metaphor_vs_simile: metaphor means cross-domain mapping without explicit comparison; simile means explicit cross-domain comparison. Same mapping receives one of these, never both. Figurative-all is union(metaphor,simile), not a sum of overlapping spans. M alias refers to metaphor only, not umbrella.
sensory_boundary: Explicit perceptible attribute or perception event only. Not every action is visual. Speech content or said/asked alone is not auditory; qualify actual sound, volume, timbre, rhythm or hearing. Visual includes explicit color/light/form/posture/expression with perceptual salience. Generic abstract distress is not bodily sensation. Kinesthetic requires represented bodily movement/balance/force sensation, not any action verb.
fantasy_boundary: Literal manifestation within the fictional world is not automatically metaphor. Sensory attributes can still qualify. Cross-domain candidate with insufficient context is uncertain, excluded from primary positive counts and retained separately.
span_boundary: Use shortest contiguous source span sufficient to justify the label; normally a clause or phrase, not a whole paragraph. For distinct cues create separate spans. Multiple sensory labels may share one span. Same-label overlaps union at aggregation; cross-label overlaps retained. Annotate full evidenced phrase if available then aggregate intersection with core.
events: Count each distinct mapping/sensory cue once; optionally add event_id to link disjoint spans. Character-union density is primary comparison when boundary/event granularity differs.
five_sense_reporting: Core five senses are visual/auditory/touch/smell/taste, labels may overlap. temperature/interoception/kinesthetic are auxiliary and must be reported separately. Each label density uses the same core-han denominator. Five-sense union excludes auxiliary-only spans. If reporting normalized five-sense shares, explicitly exclude auxiliary labels and disclose multi-label fractional-allocation method; raw densities need not total 100%.
